vantorr

The vantorr package provides an R interface to the Maxar / Vantor Hub APIs, enabling programmatic access to high-resolution satellite imagery (such as Vivid Mosaic basemaps, WorldView archives, and analysis-ready data). It natively integrates with sf, terra, and stars.

Installation

You can install the development version of vantorr from GitHub with:

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("michael-cw/vantorr")

Authentication

The Vantor API supports both API Keys (long-lived, up to 180 days) and OAuth 2.0 Bearer Tokens (session-based, with automatic refresh).

You can configure credentials in your .Renviron file (VANTOR_API_KEY, or VANTOR_USERNAME and VANTOR_PASSWORD) or set them interactively for your R session with vantor_auth():

library(vantorr)

# Option 1: Set an API Key for the session
vantor_auth(api_key = "your_api_key")

# Option 2: Authenticate via OAuth2 (automatically caches and refreshes tokens)
vantor_auth(username = "your_email@example.com", password = "your_password")

Usage

vantorr accepts spatial objects from sf, terra, and stars (as well as numeric bounding boxes in EPSG:4326 or EPSG:3857) and automatically transforms coordinates to the required projection.

library(vantorr)
library(sf)
library(terra)

# Define an Area of Interest (AOI) in WGS84 (EPSG:4326)
aoi <- st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -77.040, ymin = 38.888, xmax = -77.030, ymax = 38.892),
  crs = st_crs(4326)
)

# Retrieve a 30cm Vivid Basemap directly as a terra SpatRaster
basemap_rast <- get_maxar_wms_basemap(
  bbox = aoi,
  resolution = 0.3,
  product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",
  return_type = "SpatRaster"
)

terra::plotRGB(basemap_rast, r = 1, g = 2, b = 3, stretch = "lin")

For larger areas of interest that exceed single-request pixel limits, use get_maxar_wms_tiles() to automatically grid, download, and mosaic tiles:

large_mosaic <- get_maxar_wms_tiles(
  bbox = aoi,
  tile_size = 2500,
  resolution = 0.3,
  merge_tiles = TRUE,
  return_type = "SpatRaster"
)

Interactive leaflet Maps & R Shiny Modules

Stream Vantor Vivid mosaics (WMTS or WMS), seamline cutlines, and archive strips directly into leaflet maps, or launch the built-in interactive Shiny explorer app:

library(leaflet)
library(vantorr)

# Stream Vantor Vivid 30cm WMTS tiles and seamlines in Leaflet
leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = -104.995, lat = 39.740, zoom = 15) |>
  add_vantor_basemap(
    product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",
    service = "WMTS",
    show_seamlines = TRUE
  )

# Launch the interactive Shiny Explorer demo app
if (interactive()) {
  run_vantor_demo_app()
}

See vignette("shiny-leaflet-integration", package = "vantorr") for a complete guide to building custom leaflet + shiny applications and using the drop-in vantor_auth_ui() and vantor_explorer_ui() Shiny modules.
